description: This file defines the ArrayMapper class in the SuiteCRM utility namespace, responsible for mapping arrays or objects based on specified mappings, regex patterns, and blacklists. It includes methods for loading YAML configurations, recursive mapping, and handling various mapping strategies.

classes.name: ArrayMapper
classes.description: A class that maps arrays or objects using configurable mappings, regex patterns, and blacklists, with support for YAML configuration loading.

methods.name: getMappings
methods.description: Returns the current mappings array.

methods.name: setMappings
methods.description: Sets the mappings array and returns the instance for chaining.

methods.name: getMappable
methods.description: Returns the array or object to be mapped.

methods.name: setMappable
methods.description: Sets the array or object to be mapped, throws exception if invalid type.

methods.name: getRegexMappings
methods.description: Returns the regex mappings array.

methods.name: setRegexMappings
methods.description: Sets the regex mappings array.

methods.name: getBlacklist
methods.description: Returns the blacklist array.

methods.name: setBlacklist
methods.description: Sets the blacklist array.

methods.name: isHideEmptyValues
methods.description: Returns whether empty values are hidden.

methods.name: setHideEmptyValues
methods.description: Sets the flag to hide empty values.

methods.name: make
methods.description: Factory method to create a new ArrayMapper instance.

methods.name: map
methods.description: Performs the mapping process on the mappable data, returning the mapped array.

methods.name: loadYaml
methods.description: Loads configuration settings from a YAML file.

methods.name: mapArray
methods.description: Recursively maps an array based on the configuration.

methods.name: mapObject
methods.description: Recursively maps an object based on the configuration.

methods.name: loop
methods.description: Main recursive loop handling each key-value pair during mapping.

methods.name: handleStructure
methods.description: Handles nested arrays or objects during mapping.

methods.name: handleMap
methods.description: Handles specific key mappings based on the mappings configuration.

methods.name: handleRegex
methods.description: Handles regex-based mappings.

methods.name: handleDefault
methods.description: Handles default mapping when no other mapping applies.

methods.name: updatePath
methods.description: Updates the current path during recursive mapping.

methods.name: fixStringValue
methods.description: Decodes HTML entities in string values.

methods.name: shouldSkipEmpty
methods.description: Determines if a value should be skipped based on emptiness and configuration.

methods.name: putInPath
methods.description: Assigns a value at a specified path in the output array.

methods.name: appendInPath
methods.description: Appends a value to an array at a specified path.

methods.name: getArrayAtPath
methods.description: Retrieves a reference to the array at a given path.

methods.name: isBlackListed
methods.description: Checks if a path is in the blacklist.

methods.name: handleValue
methods.description: Handles assigning a value to a mapped path, supporting appending.
